name: Exterior Siding Stain-Blocking Prime
intent: Oil-based or modified oil stain-blocking primer for tannin bleed, water stains, or smoke damage.
doctrine: Oil-based or modified oil stain-blocking primer. Used for tannin bleed (cedar, redwood), water stains, or smoke damage. Brush rate slightly slower than acrylic (90 vs 100 SF/hr) — oil-based has different working characteristics.
